teaching_promise: The viewer can trace a model-family custody transition across weights, optimizer state, adapters, quantization, checkpoints, caches, backups, keys, hardware, holders, recipients, and descendants, then distinguish bounded load admission from release or safety claims.

story.concrete_case: A finite custody record admits one bounded model load only after artifact/lineage identity, holder, key and hardware state, attestation freshness, independent observation, copy and recipient closure, revocation, sanitization, and residual ownership are explicit.
story.opening_question: What does it mean to control a model family when its capability-bearing state is copied, reconstructed, decrypted, loaded, served, or released across trust boundaries?
story.payoff: An asset-and-derivative closure keeps custody predicates separate and fail-closed, admitting a bounded load without implying deployment, confidentiality, or safety.
story.transfer: Carry the custody record into Open-Weight Release and Post-Release Control, where unrestricted copies cannot be recalled or observed.

art_direction.visual_thesis: Model-weight custody is an effect-complete asset-and-derivative closure with independent attestation and revocation, not encryption or a hardware-root badge.
art_direction.signature_image: A dark custody vault keeps a model family and every capability-bearing derivative connected to keys, hardware, holders, recipients, descendants, and a fail-closed load airlock.
art_direction.visual_world: A model-custody control room with an asset vault, lineage graph, key lifecycle rack, attestation panel, holder/recipient ledger, sanitization bay, residual register, and load airlock.
art_direction.composition_rule: Keep canonical assets center, lineage and derivatives left, key/hardware and attestation above, holders/recipients right, and load/release/evidence boundaries at the bottom.
art_direction.palette_rule: Blue marks artifact identity and lineage, amber marks keys and authority, violet marks hardware and attestation, green marks bounded admission, red marks copies, leaks, revocation, or release, and gray marks unknown closure; every color is labeled.
art_direction.typography_rule: Use compact uppercase labels for weights, optimizer, adapter, quantization, checkpoint, cache, key, hardware, holder, recipient, descendant, revocation, and evidence boundary.
art_direction.motion_character: Assets register, derivatives branch, keys rotate, attestation freshness gates open or stop, holder/recipient rows update, sanitization validates, and the load airlock closes before post-release scope.
art_direction.camera_rule: Open on capability-bearing state sprawl, tighten on identity and key predicates, widen across holders and descendants, then return to bounded load and release handoff.
art_direction.surface_rule: Every panel names an artifact, lineage, key, environment, holder, recipient, derivative, revocation, sanitization, residual, or support boundary; no opaque closure is assumed.
art_direction.ending_image: A bounded load receipt seals while an open-weight release boundary shows irreversible copies beyond custody.

audio_direction.narration_style: Concrete, calm, and custody-specific; the asset-and-derivative closure carries the causal arc.
audio_direction.pacing_arc: Open with state sprawl, construct identity and closure, trace deterministic custody records and attestation, route key/copy failures, narrow to bounded load, then hand off to open release.
audio_direction.duration_rationale: The 04:56.490 runtime stays below the six-minute soft target while preserving asset, key, attestation, holder, derivative, revocation, and evidence distinctions; six minutes is a soft target, not a hard constraint.
audio_direction.music_policy: No music; vault movement, lineage branches, and airlock changes carry the rhythm.
audio_direction.sound_effect_policy: No sound effects; labels, arrows, crosses, and receipts encode custody meaning.

accessibility.color_redundancy: Every state and custody outcome uses labels, enclosure, position, arrow direction, line style, or crosses in addition to color.
accessibility.motion_redundancy: Every derivative and failure settles into a named state; the lineage graph, holder ledger, and airlock remain legible when motion is reduced.
accessibility.integrated_description: The adjacent transcript names artifact/lineage identity, keys, hardware, holders, recipients, descendants, attestation, sanitization, revocation, load, release, and evidence boundaries.
accessibility.caption_plan: Use exact receipt-derived cues from the pinned 20-segment narration; the adjacent transcript describes each material state change.
accessibility.reduced_motion_assessment: No flash, spin, shake, or continuous camera drift; custody and boundary relations survive pause and reduced motion.

beats.narration: Runtime authority can be governed while capability-bearing state—weights, optimizer, adapters, quantization, checkpoints, caches, recovery images, extracted equivalents, and derivatives—spreads across custody boundaries.
beats.visual_purpose: Expose custody sprawl before showing a control.
beats.visual_action: Place a canonical model in an asset vault and fan weights, optimizer, adapters, quantization, checkpoints, caches, recovery images, extracted equivalents, and recipient derivatives across storage, key, hardware, vendor, operator, and organizational boundaries.
beats.attention_target: The capability-bearing derivatives beyond the vault.
beats.composition: Canonical vault center; derivative fan around it; boundaries labeled.
beats.camera_action: Widen from canonical model to all custody surfaces.
beats.hold_purpose: Make model custody larger than the primary weight file.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative sprawl; no prevalence claim.

beats.narration: Copies, reconstruction, decryption, loading, serving, sanitization, and release can cross storage, key, hardware, vendor, operator, and organizational boundaries without effect-complete custody.
beats.visual_purpose: Show custody transitions that escape an incomplete inventory.
beats.visual_action: Move derivative tokens through storage, key, hardware, vendor, operator, and organization gates; leave unknown copies outside an incomplete-closure boundary.
beats.attention_target: Unknown copies beyond the closure line.
beats.composition: Transitions across the frame; unknown closure below.
beats.motion_curve: Fast transitions followed by a stop.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on the unknown copy boundary.
beats.hold_purpose: Make effect-complete custody a prerequisite.
beats.evidence_boundary: Closure critique; no security estimate.

beats.narration: Every governed transition needs a prospective asset-and-derivative closure bound to exact artifact and lineage identity, holder and purpose, storage and transfer state, and key and metadata lifecycle.
beats.visual_purpose: Construct the custody record before a transition.
beats.visual_action: Populate an amber custody header with artifact digest, lineage, holder, purpose, storage, transfer, key lifecycle, and metadata lifecycle fields before the load gate opens.
beats.attention_target: Artifact identity and lineage binding before movement.
beats.composition: Record above canonical asset; transition gate closed.
beats.hold_purpose: Make custody identity prospective.
beats.evidence_boundary: Record schema does not prove custody.

beats.narration: The closure also names attester, verifier, and relying-party roles; policies, reference values, endorsements, freshness, measured target and environment, dependencies, independent-enough observation, plaintext and output exposure, and separate load, use, serve, and release authority.
beats.visual_purpose: Separate trust roles, measured environment, exposure, and authority stages.
beats.visual_action: Extend the record with attester/verifier/relying-party panels, reference values, endorsements, freshness, environment, dependencies, plaintext/output exposure, and load/use/serve/release authority lanes.
beats.attention_target: Distinct verifier and separate load/use/serve/release gates.
beats.composition: Trust roles top; authority stages across bottom; exposure rows right.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent attestation from becoming universal authority.
beats.evidence_boundary: Role model does not prove hardware trust.

beats.narration: Backup and emergency recovery, copy, recipient and descendant state, incident and revocation semantics, sanitization validation, irreversible distribution, privacy, rights, cost residuals, and terminal ownership complete the custody predicates; failed predicates route to a named non-default state.
beats.sync_anchor: failed predicates route to a named non-default state
beats.visual_purpose: Complete closure with descendants, recovery, sanitization, and residual ownership.
beats.visual_action: Add backup/recovery, copy/recipient/descendant, incident/revocation, sanitization, irreversible distribution, privacy/rights/cost, and terminal owner rows; route a failed predicate to quarantine rather than default load.
beats.attention_target: Terminal owner and named non-default state.
beats.composition: Predicate rows center; failure terminal below; descendant branches right.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on failed predicate and owner.
beats.hold_purpose: Make failure route explicit.
beats.evidence_boundary: Predicate closure is not custody proof.

beats.narration: No record, encryption, signature, security level, attestation result, hardware root, key action, or deletion receipt alone proves effect-complete custody.
beats.visual_purpose: Reject single-mechanism custody shortcuts.
beats.visual_action: Stack record, encryption, signature, security level, attestation, hardware root, key action, and deletion receipt badges; cross them against the full derivative graph.
beats.attention_target: The derivative graph that remains after each badge.
beats.composition: Badges left; graph right beyond coverage boundary.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on deletion receipt vs descendants.
beats.hold_purpose: Make no single artifact sufficient.
beats.evidence_boundary: Proxy critique; no security conclusion.

beats.narration: A finite implementation can route eight deterministic custody records through one bounded-load admission, five repair, review, refresh, or observation cases, one release-laundering rejection, and one irreversible-release record.
beats.visual_purpose: Set up the finite local custody trace and its case classes.
beats.visual_action: Place eight record tiles into a deterministic router; branch bounded load, repair/review/refresh/observation, release-laundering rejection, and irreversible-release records to distinct terminals.
beats.attention_target: Case-class separation and the bounded-load route.
beats.composition: Record tiles left; router center; terminals right.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the finite test corpus inspectable.
beats.evidence_boundary: Finite local trace; no real-weight exercise.

beats.narration: Nine Lean theorem declarations under eight manifest targets prove only their explicit route consequences; nine rejecting mutations and support_state_effect=none preserve the non-claims.
beats.visual_purpose: Show formal route checks without upgrading custody evidence.
beats.visual_action: Connect eight manifest target sockets to nine theorem cards, then send nine rejecting mutations into a non-promotion boundary stamped support_state_effect=none.
beats.attention_target: The formal route scope and non-promotion stamp.
beats.composition: Manifest left, theorem cards center, rejecting mutations right.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep formal checks bounded to their routes.
beats.evidence_boundary: No real-weight, hardware, or security metric exercised.

beats.narration: No real weight, derivative closure, key, KMS or HSM, TEE, root, evidence, attestation result, verifier, reference value, endorsement, relying-party decision, plaintext load, extraction, revocation propagation, recovery, sanitization, recipient release, privacy, availability, or security metric has been exercised.
beats.visual_purpose: State the exact boundary of the finite artifact.
beats.visual_action: Keep the deterministic router in a local enclosure while a long list of unexercised real surfaces remains outside a red boundary.
beats.attention_target: The unexercised list outside the local enclosure.
beats.composition: Local records left; unexercised surfaces right beyond boundary.
beats.motion_curve: Calm enclosure and expanding nonclaim list.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the evidence ceiling concrete.
beats.evidence_boundary: No real custody or security result.

beats.narration: The design can still fail when custody sprawl escapes the closure.
beats.visual_purpose: Reopen the failure surface after the boundary statement.
beats.visual_action: Let a checkpoint, optimizer, adapter, quantization, cache, backup, package, recovery image, developer copy, recipient, and descendant token escape a closure ring.
beats.attention_target: The escaped descendant token.
beats.composition: Closure ring center; escaped tokens around it.
beats.hold_purpose: Show why closure must be effect-complete.
beats.evidence_boundary: Failure illustration; no prevalence claim.

beats.narration: Identity can be substituted after approval: artifact, lineage, tokenizer, policy, environment, holder, recipient, or model-family labels may be changed or mislabeled as equivalent.
beats.sync_anchor: identity can be substituted after approval
beats.visual_purpose: Show identity drift and false equivalence.
beats.visual_action: Replace approved artifact, lineage, tokenizer, policy, environment, holder, recipient, and family tags with near-match tokens; send mismatches to a stop gate.
beats.attention_target: The changed identity field and stop gate.
beats.composition: Approved record left; substitutions center; stop right.
beats.motion_curve: One field changes at a time, then hard stop.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on artifact digest and policy identity.
beats.hold_purpose: Make identity drift claim-bearing.
beats.evidence_boundary: Failure taxonomy; no attack-rate claim.

beats.narration: Key lifecycle drift, backup leakage, trust-anchor compromise, rotation failure, recovery abuse, break-glass authority, attestation laundering, replay, or freshness mismatch can permit use beyond purpose or usage period.
beats.visual_purpose: Show key, recovery, and freshness failures as distinct routes.
beats.visual_action: Animate a key lifecycle rack through drift, backup leak, compromised anchor, failed rotation, recovery abuse, break-glass, replay, and freshness mismatch; route each to revoke or quarantine.
beats.attention_target: Revocation and quarantine outcomes.
beats.composition: Key rack left; failure tokens center; revoke/quarantine right.
beats.camera_action: Widen across key and attestation lanes.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep key action separate from custody completeness.
beats.evidence_boundary: Failure taxonomy; no hardware compromise result.

beats.narration: The chapter remains Design rationale at argument support. Its contracts, examples, tests, or local artifacts establish only their encoded scope. The chapter names proof targets rather than pretending they are already closed.
beats.visual_purpose: Place the custody proposal at its support ceiling.
beats.visual_action: Stamp DESIGN RATIONALE / ARGUMENT SUPPORT over the local custody records while broad hardware, confidentiality, and safety proof targets remain outside.
beats.attention_target: Support stamp and open targets.
beats.composition: Local records left; open targets beyond double boundary.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent derivative support promotion.
beats.evidence_boundary: No chapter-core promotion occurs.

beats.narration: A finite record with a requested load and invalid attestation routes to block rather than readiness review, without inferring hardware compromise, weight confidentiality, safety, or ASI.
beats.visual_purpose: Show the invalid-attestation block route and its nonclaims.
beats.visual_action: Send a requested load with invalid attestation into a red block terminal; keep hardware compromise, confidentiality, safety, and ASI badges outside crossed.
beats.attention_target: Block rather than readiness review.
beats.composition: Load left; invalid receipt center; block terminal right; nonclaims below.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on invalid freshness and block.
beats.hold_purpose: Make block semantics narrower than a compromise claim.
beats.evidence_boundary: Block route does not diagnose hardware or safety.

beats.narration: A complete finite lifecycle record with current attestation, dependency disclosure, independent load observation, residual owner, and revocation semantics routes to bounded load admission without authorizing deployment.
beats.visual_purpose: Show the narrow positive route and its deployment boundary.
beats.visual_action: Populate current attestation, dependencies, independent observation, residual owner, and revocation rows; admit a bounded load while a deployment exit remains crossed.
beats.attention_target: Bounded load admission versus deployment authority.
beats.composition: Checklist left; bounded load center; deployment exit right beyond red boundary.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on residual owner and deployment cross.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the positive route intentionally narrow.
beats.evidence_boundary: Admission does not authorize deployment.

beats.narration: No chapter claim or evidence state is promoted by this visual. A named mechanism is not proof of correct implementation or useful deployment. A local check or formal model does not establish real-world enforcement. No safety, transfer, state-of-the-art, AGI, or ASI conclusion follows.
beats.visual_purpose: Prevent custody receipts from laundering into broad claims.
beats.visual_action: Keep the bounded load receipt inside a media boundary; cross implementation, deployment, enforcement, safety, transfer, frontier, AGI, and ASI exits outside.
beats.attention_target: Stop bar between local load and broad claims.
beats.composition: Receipt left; broad claims right beyond dashed boundary.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep custody evidence ceiling visible.
beats.evidence_boundary: No chapter support promotion occurs.

beats.narration: These boundaries matter because an explanatory derivative is useful only if it preserves the evidence ceiling of its source.
beats.visual_purpose: Align source and derivative at one custody support ceiling.
beats.visual_action: Connect live chapter and custody receipt with a shared evidence-ceiling line below every broad claim badge.
beats.attention_target: The shared support-state line.
beats.composition: Source left; derivative center; shared ceiling below.
beats.hold_purpose: Make evidence fidelity visible.
beats.evidence_boundary: Derivative fidelity does not increase support.

beats.narration: At most, this visual explains the chapter's design rationale at argument support; it adds no empirical, deployment, safety, transfer, state-of-the-art, AGI, or ASI result.
beats.visual_purpose: State maximum justified inference before the release successor.
beats.visual_action: Stamp DESIGN RATIONALE / ARGUMENT SUPPORT and fan red nonclaim arrows to empirical, deployment, safety, transfer, frontier, AGI, and ASI badges.
beats.attention_target: Narrow support stamp and nonclaim fan.
beats.composition: Support stamp center-left; nonclaims fan right outside boundary.
beats.hold_purpose: Close the custody chapter at its evidence ceiling.
beats.evidence_boundary: Nonclaim, not result.

beats.narration: The next chapter is Open-Weight Release and Post-Release Control. Once unrestricted weights are published, the original releaser generally cannot recall copies, enforce serving-layer safeguards, observe use, or prevent derivatives.
beats.visual_purpose: Open the irreversible-release successor boundary.
beats.visual_action: Seal the bounded load receipt and open an open-weight release boundary with copy, serving-safeguard, observation, and derivative lanes beyond custody.
beats.attention_target: The irreversible copies beyond the release boundary.
beats.composition: Receipt left; release boundary center; copies and derivatives right.
beats.camera_action: Widen from load to release surface.
beats.hold_purpose: Make post-release custody qualitatively different.
beats.evidence_boundary: Handoff adds no post-release result.

beats.narration: Unrestricted publication changes custody: copies can be reconstructed, served, modified, and passed to recipients beyond the original releaser's authority.
beats.visual_purpose: Close with the post-release custody transition.
beats.visual_action: Let open-weight copies branch into reconstructed, served, modified, and recipient derivatives while the original custody vault remains behind the boundary.
beats.attention_target: The divergence between original vault and public derivatives.
beats.composition: Original vault left behind boundary; public derivatives fan right.
beats.motion_curve: Irreversible branching with settled custody loss.
beats.hold_purpose: End on the difference between bounded load and release.
beats.evidence_boundary: Handoff adds no release or safety result.
